blocks.text: Origin / creation. Human children and later possible users encounter the External Gate as a game. They are ordinary outsiders, not destined saviors.
Identity / human status. Human. Beyond the first child, no named canonical player population or institution is fixed.
Importance. Players introduce names, preferences, mistakes, stories, strategies, attachments, combinations, and creative works that closed Codex history did not generate.
Decline or risk. A player may lose interest, age, lose access, copy a file, act carelessly, or be replaced by institutional systems. These are future Era Four questions rather than settled outcomes.

Current function. External partner and source of relational novelty. A player’s choices matter only after the cyber-pet transforms them through its own life; the player is never the pet’s owner in an identity sense.
